title: Fooled by Randomness
author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
description: A provocative argument that we consistently underestimate the role of chance in our lives, markets, and success, and that we are wired to see patterns where none exist.

title: Build, Don't Talk: Things You Wish You Were Taught in School
author: Raj Shamani
description: A no-nonsense guide to building something real, covering entrepreneurship, money, and mindset with the kind of practical lessons that classrooms never taught and experience always does.

title: Bridge to Terabithia
author: Katherine Paterson
description: A timeless story about friendship, imagination, and grief. Two children create a magical kingdom in the woods, and what happens there changes everything, quietly and forever.

title: Don't Forget 2004: Advertising Secrets of an Impossible Election Victory
author: Suhel Seth
description: A behind-the-scenes account of how one of India's most unexpected election victories was won, examining the communication strategies, creative decisions, and instincts that defied every prediction.

title: The Lost Bookshop
author: Evie Woods
description: A story woven across time, connecting three people through a mysterious bookshop that exists between streets and centuries, where books have a way of finding the readers who need them most.
